results.title: Regulation (EU) 2023/1115 on the making available on the Union market of certain commodities and products associated with deforestation
results.content: Relevant commodities and relevant products shall not be placed or made available on the market or exported, unless they are deforestation-free, produced in accordance with the relevant legislation and covered by a due diligence statement.

results.title: Regulation (EU) 2024/3234 amending Regulation (EU) 2023/1115 as regards the date of application
results.content: Postpones the application of Regulation (EU) 2023/1115: 30 December 2025 for operators and traders, 30 June 2026 for micro and small enterprises.
